headline: Profit climbs on rate recovery despite lower revenue
summary_short: OGE Energy's Q2 FY2026 net income rose 8.2% y/y to $116.3M ($0.56 diluted EPS) even as revenue fell 4.0% y/y to $711.9M on lower recoverable fuel costs and a wholesale-transmission true-up.
summary_long: Q2 FY2026 revenue was $711.9M, down 4.0% y/y as a $43.4M drop in recoverable fuel/purchased-power costs and a $12.5M SPP transmission rate true-up outweighed higher rider-recovered demand and warmer weather (33% more cooling degree days). Net income rose 8.2% y/y to $116.3M ($0.56 diluted EPS) on higher capital-investment recovery and deferral of interest expense to a regulatory asset under Oklahoma's PISA mechanism, partially offset by a 9.7% rise in O&M (contract/construction services, vegetation management, payroll). Interest expense fell 7.9% on the PISA deferral, partly offset by new $350M senior notes. OGE reaffirmed unchanged FY2026 guidance of $494-514M net income ($2.38-$2.48 diluted EPS).
